blocks.content: If you already have a query and want to understand it, paste it into Assistant and ask for an explanation. You can also ask for help optimizing a slow or overly broad query.

whenTrue.content: If this guide is docked in the sidebar, pop it out into a floating window so it stays visible beside **Assistant**.

blocks.content: To ask Assistant to explain a query, complete the following steps:
If the Assistant panel is closed, open **Assistant** from the top toolbar.

In the chat input, paste this prompt (or substitute a query from your own stack):

> Explain what this PromQL query does: `rate(http_requests_total{job="api"}[5m])`
Read the explanation and check that it matches your understanding of the selectors and functions.

You should see a plain-language explanation of the query parts (rate, labels, and range).

For more examples, refer to [Query data](https://grafana.com/docs/grafana-cloud/machine-learning/assistant/guides/querying/).
